title: Article 215 — High Courts to be courts of record

content.overview: Article 215 provides that every High Court shall be a court of record and shall have all the powers of such a court including the power to punish for contempt of itself.
content.glance: Every High Court is a court of record and may punish for contempt of itself. Parallel to Art 129 for the Supreme Court.
content.study:
Article 215 is the High Court counterpart of Article 129. As a court of record, the High Court has power to punish for contempt of itself and its acts and proceedings are recorded for perpetual memory and testimony.

Examination: court of record; contempt power; parallel Art 129.
